name: frontleap
description: Frontleap MCP servers for admin and client across development, QA, and production environments.

FRONTLEAP_DEV_URL.title: Frontleap development origin
FRONTLEAP_DEV_URL.description: Public origin for the development Frontleap app (scheme + host only, no path, no trailing slash). The plugin appends the fixed MCP path.

FRONTLEAP_QA_URL.title: Frontleap QA origin
FRONTLEAP_QA_URL.description: Public origin for the QA Frontleap app (scheme + host only, no path, no trailing slash). The plugin appends the fixed MCP path.

FRONTLEAP_PROD_URL.title: Frontleap production origin
FRONTLEAP_PROD_URL.description: Public origin for the production Frontleap app (scheme + host only, no path, no trailing slash). The plugin appends the fixed MCP path.
